page.layout: Running head at top centre with page number at top right. One column of titles with page numbers at the right, running down the page. Between the lists, two division headings span the full width: "II." above the second list and "III." above the third. A single line "LII." sits at the bottom right. No running text, notes or catchword.
page.notes: The top right number is printed as "621" (the 1 looks like a worn i). Old-style figures in the page column are read as printed; "489" for XXXV is doubtful, as the sequence suggests 409. Greek titles are copied from the print. The last line is cut at the outer edge; "Pro" is the visible part, the rest is unclear. A small stain marks the left edge of the page and is not printed text.
